requirement: The stack deploy scripts can run a second, prefixed compose stack on one host while every master command stays byte-identical

oracle.invariant: 0 failures. With no flag and no variable, deploy-tracy-stack.sh, check-server.sh and deploy-host-dsh.sh ask docker compose exactly what they asked before (no -p, the same -f files, the same env file). compose.server.yml and host-dsh.yml render and hash identically for the master whether or not the new variables are exported with their default values. --project / TRACY_COMPOSE_PROJECT (app stack) and --project / HOST_DSH_PROJECT (dsh) add -p to every compose call; TRACY_STACK_EXTRA_FILES adds one -f per entry; a missing extra file stops before anything changes. A project or a non-default dsh container with the master env file is refused with exit 2 before any docker call; invalid project and container names are refused the same way. The rollback hint is the old text with every default and a complete re-runnable command otherwise.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
